evidence.title: Allegheny County confirms measles case amid PA outbreak

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles symptoms guidance
occurrences.quote_span: The illness starts with fever, cough, runny nose and red, watery eyes, and is then followed by a rash that begins on the head or face and spreads downward.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles vaccination guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Anyone who is partially vaccinated, meaning they received one dose of the MMR vaccine rather than the recommended two, may still be susceptible to the disease.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania Department of Health vaccination status website
occurrences.quote_span: If you were vaccinated in Pennsylvania, you can check your vaccination status on the state department of health's website.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department measles vaccination guidance
occurrences.quote_span: If you have not been vaccinated, you should schedule your shots with your healthcare provider or the immunization clinic in Downton Pittsburgh, the county health department said.
occurrences.speaker: Allegheny County Health Department
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccine safety and vaccination guidance
occurrences.quote_span: If you're uncertain if you've been vaccinated, there's no risk in getting an additional dose of the MMR vaccine.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department public exposure notice
occurrences.quote_span: Shoppers at the Ross Township Target, located at 9805 McKnight Road, may have been exposed to measles on Thursday, Oct. 1 between 3:45 p.m. and 5:45 p.m.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department measles exposure guidance
occurrences.quote_span: If you believe you may have been exposed to measles, you should talk to your healthcare provider about what to do, the county health department said.
occurrences.speaker: Allegheny County Health Department
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles transmission guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Measles spreads when a person infected with the virus breathes, coughs or sneezes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department exposure investigation records
occurrences.quote_span: There were no school-related exposures in connection to this measles case.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department measles case records
occurrences.quote_span: An unvaccinated minor tested positive for measles, according to Allegheny County Health Department.
occurrences.speaker: Allegheny County Health Department
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department measles case records
occurrences.quote_span: Less than a week after Pennsylvania recorded its fifth measles-associated death and the same day the state's 2026 cases of the disease surpassed 1,000, Allegheny County confirmed its first infection in a resident.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department Oct. 5, 2026 measles press release
occurrences.quote_span: Confirmation came during the early evening of Oct. 5, when Allegheny County Health Department said in a press release that an individual under the age of 18 had tested positive for measles and may have exposed people in Ross Township.
occurrences.speaker: Allegheny County Health Department
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Centers for Disease Control measles vaccine effectiveness guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Two doses of the vaccine are about 97% effective in preventing infection, according to the Centers for Disease Control.
occurrences.speaker: Centers for Disease Control
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles transmission and environmental persistence guidance
occurrences.quote_span: It spreads through the air and on surfaces, and it can remain in the air and on surfaces for up to two hours after the person has left an area.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: Allegheny County Health Department measles exposure guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Do not go to a healthcare facility without calling ahead.
occurrences.speaker: Allegheny County Health Department
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles incubation and contagiousness guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Symptoms can show up seven to 21 days after exposure, and a person is contagious four days before and four days after the rash begins.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Allegheny County measles case
